item.description:
Dan-K is a very well-known Madonna fan and remaster, in fact he does some of the best remasters out there of her content.

Problem is that when it comes to this Girlie Show remaster, it is only available through physical format which he's selling through his website - and not only I don't have a blu-ray player but also it would be VERY expensive to import it.

Also, not only I would pay the 60 euros plus the taxes when it arrives in Brazil. Just for you guys to get it, based on a recent average Euro exchange rate of approximately R$ 5.95:
  • Customs Value (60€): ~R$ 357.00
  1. Import Tax (60%): R$ 214.20
  2. Subtotal with federal tax: R$ 571.20
  3. ICMS Calculation (17% grossed-up): R$ 571.20 ÷ 0.83 = R$ 688.19
    (The ICMS tax amount alone comes to R$ 116.99)
  • Total Accumulated Taxes: R$ 331.19
  • Estimated Total Cost: ~R$ 703.19 (Product + Taxes + Postal Fee)
In total, the final tax burden is approximately 92.7% on top of the original value in Brazilian Reais.

Unfortunately, that is unreal for me right now and I can't afford it. So I'm kindly asking, if you have bought this remaster, could you please share it? It would mean a lot to me.
